title: Page 49
transc:
Ft. Monroe Apr 5th 1864 
Maj Eckert Di
for Belcher unity your wreathe received zebra
Spaulding is at Flora zodiac Storm renders

to Annapolis zebra I have the Montauk

come in for shelter unity They can

spit Zodiac Knave would like to know
